standard-dialogue.npc: Begone afore I take my cutlass to ye! I've been charged with guardin' this gate and no noodle-armed landlubbers will make it past me alive!
Ye cheeky begger! I was wavin' my finger at ye!
Arrr... just 'cos me body happens to be 50% wood does not mean I'm heartless.
I got a bag of 'em here. Wanna see?

steps.text: If the player is not wearing a Ring of Charos:

steps.npc: That be a tale so heart-wrenchin' that it has so far wrenched the hearts from over a dozen sturdier men than thee!
A tale of such woe that none but the stoniest hearts can hear it without sheddin' a single, poignant tear...
And I'll never tell ye, not even if ye wore an item, such as a ring, with powers of mind control!
Hmmmm...well alright...
Wait, no!
Get goin' landlubber before I take my splintery foot to yer behind!

steps.text: If the player is wearing a Ring of Charos:

steps.npc: Well ye seem like a [lad/lass] that can handle such a tale...so I'll tell ye...
Well, it all starts with this albatross...
Wait, never mind, I'll skip forward a bit.
I have to [lad/lass], Cap'n Donnie will flay what little is left of me if I told ye.
But anyway, I got recruited to the zombie pirates along with the rest of the crew in an unspecified incident involvin this albatross.
We was sailin' along happily, and I was partakin' of a little 'rum' in the crows nest.
Well, we hit either a really rough wave or some rocks.
Twas kind of hard for me to tell which, as I was well out of it by then!
Regardless I toppled from the crows nest into the water.

steps.player: Is that how you got so badly injured?

steps.npc: No [lad/lass]!
What happened next was that I discovered a new, previously uncharted reef of hard, spiky coral.
I made a mental note of its location, and to this day it is still marked on our fleet's charts as Lukes Reef.
I managed to grab a hold of our ship, the Inebriated, as it passed overhead.
And then I discovered another, taller, spikier reef of even sharper and more painful coral.
To this day it is still marked on our fleet's charts as The Other 50% Reef.
It gets worse...
When they hauled what was left of me on deck, they dropped me onto the floor while they decided what to do with me.
Bear in mind this would be on a ghost ship, the planks of which sweat a thick mixture of stagnant water...and pure salt crystals.
But on the good side, all my thrashin' and pained squealin' settled the matter in the Captain's mind, and he had the shipwright carve me half a body out of his Witchwood Planks.
Tis a special, magical wood from a now extinct tree.
Once they nailed it all in place the stuff moves like it is part of me body.
The stuff will also grow back if it breaks, which is dead handy!

steps.player: Wow, that stuff must be very valuable!

steps.npc: Arr! That it be!
So, that be the tale of how I managed to lose precisely 50% of my body.
What kind of a question is that?

steps.text: If the player does not have a tinderbox:

steps.npc: Ye've got that right!

steps.text: If the player has a tinderbox:

steps.player: I'll soon have you out of the way! Burn!

steps.text: The player does the tinderbox lighting animation.

steps.npc: Don't make me angry! Ye'll not like me when I'm angry!

steps.text: The screen turns black and a message appears saying "One 500 hit combo later..."

steps.npc: Let that be a lesson to ye!

steps.player: My world is an ocean of paaaain!

options.text: So what is going on here anyway?

steps.player: So what is going on here anyway?

steps.npc: Ye expect me to talk?

steps.player: No Mr. Luke, I expect you to die!

steps.npc: Hah! I'm one step ahead of ye!

steps.player: Egad, outsmarted by the man with the wooden brain.
But seriously, what is going on here?

steps.npc: I can't tell ye [lad/lass].
The Cap'n would have me whittled down to toothpicks if I did.

steps.player: Well if you can't tell me, perhaps you could show me through the medium of Interpretive Dance?

steps.npc: No. Just...no.
Look, [lad/lass] I'm not tellin' ye a thing! So clear out while ye still can!

standard-dialogue-using-a-tinderbox-on-5.text: Starts above from "I'll soon have you out of the way! Burn!"

using-the-gate-near-50-luke-from-the-sou.npc: Arr! Tryin' ter get away eh? Well ye'll never sneak past me, I'm the best lookout this crew has ever seen!

steps.player: Who's that making faces behind you?
That is the most amazing thing I have ever seen!
Oh my! Is that a genuine 3rd Age Diversion?

using-the-gate-near-50-luke-from-the-nor.npc: Hey! What are you doing out there?
Well Cap'n Donnie said no livin' landlubbers were allowed out of the compound.
So get yerself back in here, or yer for it!
